faq.description: Everything you need to know about creating links, completing actions and unlocking content with Link4Sub.

noAccount.question: Do viewers need a Link4Sub account to unlock content?
noAccount.answer: No. Viewers only need to complete the required actions and continue — no account registration is needed.

verify.question: How does Link4Sub verify that an action was completed?
verify.answer: Link4Sub checks with the relevant platform (YouTube, Discord, Telegram...) to confirm the action actually happened before unlocking the content.

content.question: What kinds of content can I lock behind a link?
content.answer: A URL, an uploaded file, or a saved block of text — any destination you want viewers to complete an action before reaching.

spam.question: Will my audience be spammed?
spam.answer: No. Link4Sub only asks for the actions you choose when creating the link, and never sends notifications or emails on your behalf.

platformChange.question: What if a platform changes how it works?
platformChange.answer: The Link4Sub team continuously monitors supported platforms and updates as soon as needed, so your links keep working reliably.

dropoff.question: Can I see who clicked but didn't complete the steps?
dropoff.answer: Yes. The dashboard shows views and completions for each link, so you can see exactly where people drop off in the unlock flow.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.description: Everything you need to know about how Link4Sub calculates and pays out your earnings.

calculation.question: How are payout rates calculated?
calculation.answer: Rates are based on the reference CPM for each country and device type, multiplied by the revenue share percentage tied to your current account level.

updateFrequency.question: Do rates change often?
updateFrequency.answer: Yes. Rates are updated periodically based on shifts in the ad market, so the figures on this page are only a reference at the time you view them.

levelImpact.question: How does my account level affect the payout rate?
levelImpact.answer: The higher your level, the larger your revenue share. The table above shows the maximum currently attainable rate.

deviceDifference.question: Why do Mobile and Desktop rates differ?
deviceDifference.answer: Ad value per device varies by market, so Link4Sub separates Mobile and Desktop rates to reflect actual earnings accurately.

minimumPayout.question: When can I withdraw my earnings?
minimumPayout.answer: You can submit a withdrawal request as soon as your available balance reaches the minimum threshold shown in your Dashboard.

referralStack.question: Does referral commission stack with payout rates?
referralStack.answer: Yes. Referral commission is calculated separately and added on top of the earnings from your standard payout rate.

source.question: Where does this data come from?
source.answer: Each row is a real withdrawal request that has been marked as paid in the system. Pending, processing, rejected and cancelled requests are not shown.

masked.question: Why are member names hidden?
masked.answer: To protect privacy, only the first few characters of a name are shown. Emails and payout account details are never made public.

amount.question: Which amount is displayed?
amount.answer: It is the amount the member actually received after withdrawal fees, in the currency used at the time of the withdrawal.

update.question: How often is the list updated?

withdraw.question: How do I get paid?

faq.title: Before you message us, these answers cover most questions

views.question: What counts as a view?
views.answer: A visit that completes every step of the link and passes the system's quality checks. Duplicate visits, bot traffic and unusual traffic are not counted.

revenue.question: How is my revenue calculated?
revenue.answer: Revenue is based on your views and the payout rate for each country, device type and your account tier. See the details on the Overview and Payout rates pages.

tiers.question: How are member tiers determined?
tiers.answer: Tiers are based on your total views in the latest cycle and update automatically. See each tier's requirements and perks on the Loyalty page.

withdraw.question: When can I withdraw?
withdraw.answer: You can request a withdrawal once your balance reaches the minimum. The minimum, payment methods and processing status are shown on the Withdraw page.

brokenLink.question: My link isn't working. What should I do?
brokenLink.answer: Check the destination and the steps configured for the link. If it still fails, create a support request with the link URL and a screenshot so we can check it faster.

tracking.question: Where can I track the requests I've sent?
tracking.answer: All your requests are listed right on this page. Open one to see its status, replies from the support team and to add more information when needed.
